assertions.name: flavor_split_matches_codata
assertions.source: Relative error of the leading substrate flavor split (m_n−m_p)/M_N = (q−1)²(1−q⁻⁴)/3 (via _li_2_q_util.flavor_split_leading) vs the CODATA split (M_N_MEV_VALIDATION−M_P_MEV_VALIDATION)/M_N, evaluated at the canonical muon-anchored substrate q₀ (50 dps). No fitted quark mass. Passes iff rel err < 2e-3 (0.2 %); measured ≈ 1.3e-3.

assertions.name: two_algebraic_forms_agree_exactly
assertions.source: Exact identity (q−1)²(1−q⁻⁴)/3 == ℏ_q²·h_q·[2]_q/3 checked at compute precision; both are the same Laurent polynomial in q.

description: Verify the substrate-pure proton–neutron flavor-split closed form (m_n−m_p)/M_N = (q−1)²(1−q⁻⁴)/3 = ℏ_q²·h_q·[2]_q/3 (the PROVEN leading form; the posited (1+ℏ_q³) subleading is NOT this block's claim) at the canonical muon-anchored substrate q₀, via the shared canonical utility _li_2_q_util.flavor_split_leading. No fit and no u–d mass input: only q₀ and the nucleon scale M_N enter. Compares to the CODATA split built from codata_constants.M_{P,N}_MEV_VALIDATION (single source), cross-checks the two algebraic forms agree exactly, and asserts archimedean agreement < 0.2 % (measured ≈ 0.13 %, the block's −0.10 % leading residual).
